The Flintstones comic strip began October 2, 1961 "1961 Timeline, October 2: The Flintstones spins off into newspapers in a new comic strip illustrated by Gene Hazelton and Roger Armstrong." American Comic Book Chronicles: 1960–64 by John Wells, TwoMorrows Publishing, 2012, Page 43..
Illustrated by Gene Hazelton and Roger Armstrong, and distributed by the McNaught Syndicate, it ran from 1961 to 1988.
After McNaught went out of business, The Flintstones was picked up by Editors Press Service and drawn by Karen Matchette until 1998 Comic Strip Fan: The Flintstones .

Western Publishing put out various titles of The Flintstones from 1961-70:
The Flintstones by Dell Comics for 5 issues in 1961-62 and by Gold Key Comics for 54 issues in 1962-701

The Flintstones Top Comics by Gold Key for 4 issues in 1967
